testcases.name: pixart-sigma-1024
testcases.l0_replacement_reason: PixArt-Sigma scale stays nightly; pixart-sigma-1024-l0 keeps the PixArt image path at 512px for PR L0.
testcases.description: PixArt-Sigma XL-2 text-to-image (T5-XXL + DiT ada_norm_single + 4ch VAE)
testcases.test_prompt: A photo of a cat sitting on a windowsill at sunset
testcases.notes: PixArt-Sigma uses an FP16 DiT and VAE with only component 0, the T5-XXL encoder, retained in FP32. T5 FP16 produced NaNs at the first denoising step; isolated FP16 DiT and VAE runs and the final mixed bundle pass the unchanged FP32 Diffusers image contract.
